overview: Docket indexes Grew's report on Hoshino's view that Taiwan's industry peaked and Hainan should develop next, and Chongqing's translated military intelligence on Taiwan.

people.name: Joseph C. Grew
people.role: Named parenthetically as the sender of the indexed Japan telegram; role not stated on the sheet

people.name: Naoki Hoshino
people.role: President of the Cabinet Planning Board

people.name: George Atcheson Jr.
people.role: Named parenthetically in the entry for the indexed Chongqing communication; role not stated on the sheet

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry for Grew telegram on Taiwan and Hainan
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes Grew’s March 26 telegram reporting Hoshino’s remarks about the limits of Taiwanese industrial development and the proposed development of Hainan.
subfiles.summary: Docket: Grew reports Hoshino believes Taiwan's industry has peaked, favoring Hainan for the next development push.

subfiles.title: Duplicate list-of-papers entry for Atcheson communication on Taiwan
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes an Atcheson communication from Chongqing containing translated documents with information about Taiwan, chiefly military in character.
subfiles.summary: Docket: Atcheson's Chongqing communication contained translated military intelligence on Taiwan, now filed elsewhere.

interest: Shows Japan's wartime plans to shift development focus from Taiwan to Hainan, and Chongqing intelligence on Taiwan.
